Overview.what: Shares in the system's companies, priced around the clock. Prices follow the cargo markets at the stations each company trades with, run in rising and falling stretches that last weeks, and creep upward over the years. Buy on the way up, sell before the turn, and don't borrow to sit on shares: a loan costs more than they earn on average.
Overview.holdings: Your shares are worth {0} at today's selling prices.
Overview.wire_quiet: Nothing on the wire yet. Big moves and turns show up here and in the crew log.
Overview.how: Pick a company for its chart and to trade. Every order pays the spread (the gap between the buying and selling price) and a commission, and a big order nudges the price against you, so quick round trips lose money. Price alerts tell you when a company reaches a level, even while you skip time.
